items.title: Dave McKenna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: I hear he only took one solo in his life on a record, and it was a record with Fats Waller.

ctx.x: He was sort of subdued, but he was still a funny man. And he played. Oh he came up to play a few times. Usually he’d sit and talk with the people. But he played good rhythm and all the right chords. I hear he only took one solo in his life on a record, and it was a record with Fats Waller. Somebody told me that, I don’t know if that’s true.
Did he just play a four string guitar or something?
